title: Who holds a context
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. A context's holders were recorded with each cut.
decision: A context is held by the architect the operator works with on it, or by a persona over the architect named for it. Cratylus's own five contexts are held by the architect.
consequences: A standing record of each context's holder beside its description is future work for the journal.
